subject: science
passage: The flowers of some hydrangeas change color depending on the soil they grow in. In acidic soil, the plants can absorb aluminum, which turns their flowers blue. In less acidic soil, the aluminum stays locked in forms the roots cannot take up, and the flowers stay pink. ______ two plants of the same variety may bloom blue in one garden and pink in another.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The text explains that soil acidity controls whether hydrangeas can take up aluminum, and that aluminum makes the flowers blue. The last sentence describes what follows from this: identical plants can bloom in different colors in different soils. A cause-and-effect transition is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The last sentence does mention two colors, but it does not contrast with the explanation before it; it follows from that explanation.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Similarly" signals a parallel fact, but the last sentence is a consequence of how soil affects color.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Nevertheless" signals something surprising given what came before, but different colors in different gardens are exactly what the explanation predicts.
explanation.D: Correct. "As a result" shows that plants of one variety can bloom in different colors because soil acidity controls their uptake of aluminum.
